# Simon Lowes

> Simon Lowes is an alternative rock musician, singer-songwriter, and guitarist.

## Overview

Simon Lowes creates alternative rock music with melodic, introspective songwriting. His sound blends rock, alternative, and indie influences with thoughtful lyrics and guitar-driven arrangements.

## Music

Listen to Simon Lowes on:
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1E8slBJPNvUSPpRIh3xtkI)
- [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/gb/artist/simon-lowes/1351008298)
- [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com/channel/UCI4xshiWQrOu_27TPmW9A2g)
- [Bandcamp](https://simonlowes.bandcamp.com)
